'''2013 Worlds Day 1 Drew Powers LS Rescue The Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Drew Powers]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Rebort
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
